voice.error: Sorry, something went wrong on our side. Please call again in a little while.
voice.unknown_ref: Sorry, I couldn't save your details just now. Please call again in a little while.
voice.consent_required: No problem. Without your consent to AI calls we can't register you. Thank you!
voice.registered: Our team will check your ID, and then you'll start getting jobs.
voice.already_registered: You're already registered with Suvidha. We'll call you when a job comes up.
voice.open_job_draft: We've sent you a question on WhatsApp about your {trade} job; please answer it there.
voice.open_job_inviting: We're collecting rates from workers for your {trade} job and will send them on WhatsApp.
voice.open_job_quotes: We've sent the rates for your job on WhatsApp; please pick a worker there.
voice.open_job_booked: {trade} {worker} will do your job, arriving by about {eta}.

whatsapp.ask_trade: Which worker do you need: carpenter, plumber or electrician?
whatsapp.ask_job_type: What work needs to be done? Please reply in one line.
whatsapp.ask_problem: Please describe the problem in one line.
whatsapp.ask_material: Do you already have the parts needed (for example a hinge, tap or switch), or should the worker bring them?
whatsapp.ask_address: Please share your full address with a nearby landmark.
whatsapp.ask_time_window: By when do you need the work done?
whatsapp.ask_priority: How should we sort the rates for you: earliest arrival, lowest price, or best rated?
whatsapp.card_complete: Thank you. Your request is complete, and we are now collecting rates from workers near you.
whatsapp.change_noted: Your change has been noted, and workers already contacted have been informed. Their rates may change, but will stay within the range each of them quoted.
whatsapp.photo_received: Photo received. We will share it with the workers.
whatsapp.no_workers: We are sorry. No worker is available for this job in your area right now.
whatsapp.shortlist_visit_title: Will quote after seeing the work:
whatsapp.shortlist_later: {count} more worker(s) can come only after your preferred time. They are listed at the end.
whatsapp.shortlist_no_photo: Note: No photo was shared, so these rates are based on your call. The final price may change after the worker sees the job, within the range quoted.
whatsapp.not_chosen_worker: Thank you for sharing your rate. The customer has booked another worker this time.
whatsapp.login_code: Your Suvidha login code is *{code}*. It is valid for 10 minutes. Do not share this code with anyone.
whatsapp.finish_code_customer:
*Job marked as done*
{name} has marked your job ({job}) as done.
Final price: {price}

If you are satisfied with the work, share this finish code with them: *{otp}*
If not, do not share the code. Reply here and we will help.
